name: bright-data
description: Web search, content extraction, structured data, and browser automation powered by Bright Data's web intelligence platform.

skills.name: bd-batch-scrape
skills.description: Process up to 10 URLs or search queries in a single parallel call. Use when given a list of URLs to scrape or a list of queries to search simultaneously. Significantly faster than running them one by one.

skills.name: bd-browser
skills.description: Real browser automation for JS-heavy, interactive, or login-gated pages. Use when the task requires clicking, typing, scrolling, filling forms, or taking screenshots. Supports a Puppeteer/Playwright-style flow via MCP tools. Requires Browser zone (PRO tier). Use bd-scrape for sta

skills.name: bd-code
skills.description: Use when the user wants to WRITE CODE that integrates Bright Data APIs — Python or Node.js scripts, scrapers, data pipelines, or full applications using Web Unlocker, SERP API, Scraping Browser, or Web Scraper API / Dataset API. NOT for querying live data — use bd-search, bd-scra

skills.name: bd-scrape
skills.description: Fetch and extract content from any URL, bypassing bot protection, CAPTCHAs, and geo-blocks using Bright Data's Web Unlocker. Returns clean Markdown by default. For multiple URLs use scrape_batch. NOT for search engine queries (use bd-search) or interactive/login-gated pages (use

skills.name: bd-search
skills.description: DEFAULT for all web search tasks. Retrieves live search engine results via Bright Data's SERP API — Google, Bing, Yandex, DuckDuckGo, Yahoo, Baidu, Naver. Use for any research, lookup, or question needing current web data. Use bd-structured-data instead for platform-specific data

skills.name: bd-structured-data
skills.description: Pull pre-structured, cleaned data from 100+ platforms including Amazon, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Zillow, Crunchbase, and more. Returns clean JSON — no parsing required. Requires PRO_MODE=true or GROUPS config. Always prefer this over bd-browser for supported

subagents.name: web-researcher
subagents.description: Autonomous research agent using Bright Data's full web intelligence stack. Searches, scrapes, and structures web data to answer complex questions with fully cited sources. Use for deep, multi-source research tasks.

rules.name: bright-data-usage
rules.description: Routing guide for Bright Data tools — which product to use for each web data task.

rules.name: citation-standards
rules.description: Citation standards for Bright Data web search and scrape results. Applied when presenting findings from search_engine, scrape_as_markdown, or web_data_* tools.

commands.name: bd-setup
commands.description: Set up the Bright Data plugin — configure API credentials and verify MCP connection

commands.name: bd-search
commands.description: Search the web using Bright Data's SERP API. Usage: /bd-search <query>

commands.name: bd-scrape
commands.description: Scrape content from a URL using Bright Data's Web Unlocker. Bypasses bot protection and CAPTCHAs. Usage: /bd-scrape <url> [url2] [url3]

commands.name: bd-browser
commands.description: Launch a Scraping Browser session for interactive or JS-heavy pages. Supports click, type, scroll, screenshot. Usage: /bd-browser <url>

commands.name: bd-data
commands.description: Pull structured data from 100+ platforms: Amazon, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Zillow, and more. Usage: /bd-data <platform> <url-or-keyword>

commands.name: bd-status
commands.description: Check Bright Data MCP connection status and view tool usage for this session

commands.name: bd-code
commands.description: Generate Bright Data integration code — Python or Node.js. Usage: /bd-code <product> <language> [use-case]
